title: Monserrat and Wine - a great combination!
text: Greatly day getting out of Barcelona to Monserrat. Started with approx 50 minute bus trip to the train station for the ascent through the clouds to beautiful Monserrat. Next up was a vertical well presented and highly entertaining walking tour with our excellent guide Kyra ( whose English is absolutely excellent). We then had enough free time to go up the funicular railway to the viewing area overlooking the monastery and surrounding countryside - absolutely stunning.
